description: The whole-cohort document: cumulative incidence of the four competing exits (drained, abandoned, dormant, none) at 30, 60, 90 and 180 days with the numbers at risk and the restricted mean time without an exit (ladder.exit_incidence.v1); the Standardised Drain Ratio per minting address with 30 or more ranked agents, with 95% intervals (platform.sdr.v1); the day-to-day transition matrix between L7, L8, L9 and out (ladder.transition.v1); and the landmark re-check of the published survival figures (survival.landmark.v1).
name: ladder_dynamics
title: How ranked agents end, and which platforms drain more than the market (free)
